decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box builds on the firm's metal fabrication skills but enters a new sewer application, so the firm can partially interpret early results and keep it.
Public waste bins are standard fabricated metal products closely related to the firm's existing knowledge, making it easy to assimilate feedback.
Ground sleeves for posts align directly with the firm's core metalworking capabilities, so the firm can readily recognize and use improvement opportunities.
Cast iron ground sleeves require casting knowledge distant from the firm's fabricated metal processes, limiting its ability to learn from and improve the product.
Steel ground sleeves are a core fabricated metal product well within the firm's existing absorptive capacity, so it can confidently interpret market signals.
